Hi Logan,

I just completed the self-signup flow on your site requesting a Private/VPC demo for Novacare. We're evaluating a VPC/on-prem path because we'll be processing PHI and need tenant isolation, KMS integration, and audit logs.

High-level ask: a 45–60 minute technical demo focused on deployment options, network requirements, and evidence we can present to our security/compliance team (SOC2, data retention, audit logs).

Preferred window: Oct 12–14 in the morning ET (we're on Eastern US). If possible, include an ops/architecture engineer and someone who can speak to the security/compliance evidence.

Attaching a quick intake form we filled out (security_questionnaire_filled.pdf).

Attendees (so far): Emma Ross (Security Lead) — emma.ross@novacare.com

Thanks,
Emma

Hi Emma — thanks for submitting this and for the intake form. I'm Logan on the SDR team; happy to coordinate.

We can absolutely do a focused session on VPC/on-prem patterns and the kinds of evidence you mentioned. Quick ask before we lock the slot: could you confirm if Novacare would like a: (a) security-first briefing (SOC2 + KMS + audit logs) followed by ops deep-dive, or (b) combined 45-minute demo covering both? Option (a) lets us bring a compliance SME.

Proposed slots (all ET):
 - Tue Oct 12 — 09:30–10:15
 - Wed Oct 13 — 10:00–10:45
 - Thu Oct 14 — 11:00–11:45

If none of those work, tell us a timezone and a 2-hour window and we'll stitch something together. I've looped in Grace (Solutions Engineer) for the technical walkthrough and Neha (Customer Success) to help coordinate any procurement/compliance asks.

I'll also drop a calendar invite once you confirm a slot. We'll attach a short pre-demo checklist (network + firewall ports + sample artifacts) so your IT team can pre-stage anything we need.

HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/2345

Best,
Logan Wright
SDR, Redwood Inference

Grace will lead the technical demo and will follow up with a short preflight doc for your team. HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/2345 (I've updated the preferred slot)

Looking forward to it — see you Oct 13 16:30 ET.

Hi Emma / Sam — thanks for confirming and for the diagram. Quick pre-demo questions so we come prepared:

1) Do you plan to run the pilot in a single VPC per environment or separate VPCs per tenant? (this affects the isolation demo and routing examples)
2) Do you have a preferred KMS provider (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HSM)? Any existing key policies we should be aware of?
3) Would you like us to demo the audit log export and a short playback of a sample request in the control plane? If so, please share a redacted log entry (one line) before Oct 11.

I'll attach a short preflight checklist that maps directly to the items Logan listed so Sam can run through it with infra.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
